theme: A travel day — I-95 south, Florida at the far end.
greeting: The whole day is the road, Dan — Fredericksburg behind you and the St. Pete cottage opening tomorrow. The calendar is clear of meetings; the real business is two holiday-travel bookings whose windows have quietly closed.

needsAttention.title: Book the Portland Christmas SUV — refundable, now
needsAttention.detail: On your Mike + Dan board, flagged p1 and "book this week" back on Sept 14. Christmas is the next time all four girls come up to Maine and the Pathfinder is south for the winter, so there's no six-seater waiting — a full-size SUV out of PWM over the holidays sells out, and a refundable hold costs nothing.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December-break trip for the girls
needsAttention.detail: Your board's book-by of Oct 15 has now passed, for the Dec 13–Jan 2 window with all four girls. Holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year and only gets dearer — the domestic-shortlist path has nothing to wait on.

schedule.title: Check out, point south
schedule.detail: Fredericksburg hotel closes out; car onto I-95 south.

schedule.title: The long middle
schedule.detail: Open miles — nothing on the calendar asks for you.

schedule.title: Toward the cottage
schedule.detail: Closing the distance to Coffee Pot Bayou, which opens tomorrow.

flagged.title: A contact's email was hacked
flagged.detail: Philip warned Sunday that his account was compromised — don't open the earlier "Documents" file he appeared to share; delete it.

flagged.title: NACD New England event is next Wednesday
flagged.detail: The Oct 28 Run of Show went round to the full invite list you're on — a governance room worth arriving prepared for.

flagged.title: Your mom's KDP account still points to Drew
flagged.detail: Drew forwarded a Kindle royalty notice for Sandra's account that landed with him — the contact email you thought you'd switched hasn't taken.

flagged.title: Tokyo / Valoris call moving off Nov 4
flagged.detail: On the Independent Managers Club thread you're cc'd on, Mike Lubrano asked to shift the call to Tuesday Nov 3 — nothing owed from you.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promos — Bloomberg, the Press Herald, Italian Word of the Day, a few shop sales and a Todoist nudge.

resolved: The seasonal Pathfinder drive south is actually underway — the Fredericksburg hotel is behind you and the St. Pete cottage is booked from tomorrow, replacing this winter's run of 28-day Florida rentals.

recipe.title: Pumpkin chiffon pie
recipe.why: Deep in squash season, this cloud-light pie is the sweet payoff to a long drive — bank it for when the St. Pete kitchen is yours again.

tasks.title: Portland house order — king bedframe + outdoor-shower soap holder

acts.line: No meetings on the books today, a rare open stretch between the legs of the drive south.
The St. Pete cottage opens tomorrow, so today is the slack before the last long leg down I-95.
A quiet night in Virginia before Florida takes over the calendar.
